text.en: Rishi from Jammu visits his Mama in a Himalayan village. He sees many colourful flowers. His cousin says there is a Kashmir tulip festival at this time of year.

Rishi, from Jammu, travels by bus with his parents to the Himalayas to visit his Mama, Mami and cousins Chiya and Nonikaa.
On the way the roads have hairpin turns and the hills are covered with colourful flowers.
In the garden he sees a rose, a marigold and a hibiscus, and a flower he does not know. Nonikaa says it is a tulip.
In spring there is a tulip festival in Kashmir. Rishi tells them of a red flower, buransh, or Rhododendron, which blooms in spring in his place.
Festivals are celebrated all over India. Some are about the seasons, harvests and flowers.
At lunch they eat a Kashmiri dish called haakh, a leafy vegetable, with hot rice.
